title: Thermal system troubleshooting
excerpt: When the printer reports overheating, inspect ventilation paths and verify that cooling fans are operating. Stop operation and escalate if the temperature remains above the permitted range.

title: Cooling and ventilation inspection
excerpt: A recurring temperature alarm may indicate restricted airflow or an impaired cooling subsystem. Record the alarm code and operating conditions before escalating to maintenance.

title: Paper feeding troubleshooting
excerpt: When paper feeding is interrupted, inspect the paper path for obstructions and verify that the paper is correctly positioned. Escalate if the issue persists.
